intuition: Fill the output from the right so values already in nums1 are not overwritten before comparison.

brute_force.approach: Copy nums1's initialized prefix, concatenate nums2, and sort the destination.

optimal.approach: Compare the largest remaining values and write each into the last free slot, moving backward until nums2 is exhausted.

edge_cases: Equal values may be placed in either order.
The initialized prefix of nums1 must remain available until consumed.
